versions.short: The resolution sets out a procedure that allows the Senate to consider, all together in one vote while in executive session, a long list of presidential nominations now waiting on the Executive Calendar. The nominees cover a wide range of posts, including ambassadors and diplomatic representatives, United States Attorneys and Marshals, judges of the Superior Court and Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia, members of federal boards and commissions, and senior officials at the State, Treasury, Labor, Energy, Homeland Security, Defense, and other departments.
